description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for the 'categories' table, providing methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting category data within a Room database in an Android application.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for 'categories' table, including methods to retrieve, insert, find, update, and delete category entities.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all CategoryEntity items ordered by name (case-insensitive).

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new CategoryEntity into the database with conflict strategy set to ignore existing records.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a category by its name, returning the CategoryEntity if found.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the name of a category identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a category record based on its ID.
